<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
  <title>Sphere</title>
  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    :root {
      --bg-start: #eef2f7;
      --bg-end: #cdd6e4;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root {
        --bg-start: #1b2230;
        --bg-end: #0b0e14;
      }
    }

    html,
    body {
      height: 100%;
    }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, var(--bg-start), var(--bg-end));
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    .sphere {
      width: min(400px, 80vmin);
      height: min(400px, 80vmin);
      display: block;
      overflow: visible;
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .sphere circle {
      filter: drop-shadow(0 24px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35));
    }

    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50%      { transform: translateY(-14px); }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .sphere {
        animation: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg
    class="sphere"
    viewBox="0 0 400 400"
    role="img"
    aria-label="A glossy blue sphere"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <defs>
      <radialGradient id="shade" cx="38%" cy="32%" r="72%">
        <stop offset="0%"  stop-color="#9ad0ff"/>
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#3b82f6"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#14307a"/>
      </radialGradient>

        <stop offset="0%"  stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
      </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="190" fill="url(#shade)"/>
    <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="190" fill="url(#highlight)"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>
